column1: # Path-cohort ledger — every path-like parameter, classified.
# Generated by session 167 from live measurement against Godot 4.7 (editor + a running
# game), one line per row, TAB separated:  tool <TAB> param <TAB> class <TAB> reason
#   guarded          refuses an escaping res://.. spelling, naming the parameter
#   node-path        addresses a node in a scene tree; cannot express a filesystem escape
#   not-a-path       enumerator over-inclusion; the value is not a path at all
#   capability-gated the plane's capability check answers before the guard is reached
#   do-not-reopen    a plane with its own dedicated pass (166 §8.38)
#   backend-absent   needs a backend that cannot be installed on the measuring host
#   stores-only      stored verbatim and never resolved; see the reason for why that is legitimate
# 🔴 THIS FILE IS A GATE, NOT A NOTE. `AUTH_PATH_LEDGER` fails when the live cohort and
# this ledger disagree in EITHER direction — a new parameter nobody classified, or an
# entry whose row no longer exists. That is the whole point: 162's conclusion survived
# three sessions because it was compiled into a tool with no way to notice it had gone
# stale. An entry here cannot outlive its row.
